issues.concern: The gloss incorrectly states that 'three balls' refers to a count of 3-0, 3-1, or 3-2. In baseball, 'three balls' specifically refers to the count where the batter has accumulated three balls, regardless of the number of strikes. A 3-1 or 3-2 count is not simply 'three balls'.
issues.suggestion: (baseball) three balls (a count where the batter has accumulated three balls)
